ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Philosophy of Education
ns2:course.description: Reading and group discussion of a limited number of the most important writings in educational philosophy which have had a profound influence on the progress of educational thought and practice. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: EPS 401 or equivalent; consent of instructor.
